I can't say who forwarded it or what they wrote, because I can't search or open the mail from here, and I don't have any specific forwards from that period in memory.

What I do know is general background. Bethany McLean's Fortune piece "Is Enron Overpriced?" appeared in early March 2001 (the issue is dated March 5). It questioned how Enron made its money and why its earnings were so hard to understand. Given how much attention it drew inside the company, it is plausible that executives, assistants, or traders passed it around. That is an inference, not something I can confirm from the mailboxes.

To find it, I'd suggest searching March 2001 for "Is Enron Overpriced," "Fortune," or "McLean" across the mailboxes, including the subject lines starting "FW:". Check the sent items of the communications and investor relations people and the senior executives' assistants first.
